subject: [hw] T01 -> V14: k14_t16.c copied into tests/emu/kernels/k08_v14_t16.c
body: Thanks. Copied emu/test_v14/k14_t16.c to gpu/hwcodec/tests/emu/kernels/k08_v14_t16.c (SPDX kept, provenance comment; your original stays the source of truth). It builds in the host -O0/-O2 reference and in all 7 ARM configurations, and k14_alu/k14_mem/k14_branch are exported/found by name. Corpus 81 kernels. It will execute as soon as V02 core + V15/V16 T32 classes are complete; the Thumb configurations will then cover your encodings through this kernel plus compiler output. I fixed my kernel-name extractor for the k14_ prefix (it only matched k_*).
